title: Has AI changed the way you design games, not just the way you write code?
author: ArtificialObserver44

comments.author: EC36339
comments.body: Absolutely. It is great for organizing ideas.

replies.author: ArtificialObserver44
replies.body: It surprised me how well codex separates and organises files and folders. its regularly clearing away redundant files, something thats difficult to keep on top of if doing it all manually.

replies.author: EC36339
replies.body:
I set the file folder structure myself, but only for organising development, not design and brainstorming.

* One main folder, one structure that I define in a README.md. No ad hoc dumping if files and folders anywhere without order.
* I have a template folder for templates of recurring files auch as bug lists, plans, questions, decisions, etc.
* I have skills for writing certain files that enaure a certain process. For example, when I say "write a spec", the AI will include the original prompt verbatim so I don't lose it, and it will ask, if not told, whether or not to include implementation details or stay high level, so it doesn't get lost in details too early, which then are hard to remove from its session context.

I do not have a structure for game design, though. I have one "design" folder that I deliberately allow to be messy, informal and just text, no structure. AI is not allowed to look into it unless explicitly told to. I organize this raw material into specifications and plans, but I probably need a layer in between, a more organized design layer.

replies.author: ArtificialObserver44
replies.body: I also started with .md files for the basis but it has permission to add and delete as necessary new files it creates. im also creating back ups so i can easily jump back to older states without having to get it to undo things and it can also compare more easily incase it has deleted something and cant remember. it periodically breaks a simulation mechanic whilst implementing a new one even though it thinks its remained intact.

comments.author: AndreRieu666
comments.body:
One of the biggest helps is to lean into this even further:

Ask ”grill me on how \_\_\_\_ should work”.   
It’s AMAZING the things it will consider that you haven’t yet.
